entries.title: Page through your backlog on the task board
entries.body: The task board's Backlog column now pages like Queued and Working: Previous and Next show five tasks at a time, with where you are in the backlog beside them, and the arrow keys walk on to the next page. The Backlog button still opens the whole backlog as a list.

picture.alt: The task board's Backlog column on its second page, showing 6–10 of 12 with Previous and Next, beside Queued showing 1–5 of 7 with Previous and Next
